# These tests ALSO fail on a pristine upstream FPC `main` build in the same
# CI environment -- they are inherited from upstream, NOT caused by the

# (glibc symbol versioning, ISO mode runtime, a known segfault, etc.).

# regressions are still caught. If an entry below starts PASSING, CI prints
# a warning so it can be removed from this list.
